Sar Jhukate Nahi Katate Hain.
Haq Ka Rasta Humein Dikhate Hain.

1
Yeh Hai Ahsan Aal-e-Ahmad Ka.
Keh Laho Se Diye Jalate Hain.
Aise Marne Ki Ki Humein Talqeen.
Aise Jeena Huemin Sikhate Hain.

2
Lash-e-Akbar Akele Maqtal Mein.
Kitni Himat Se Sheh Uthate Hain.
Karbla Wale Phir Humein Qabil.
Apni Dehleez Par Bulate Hain.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/sar-jhukate-nahi-katate-hain-tajpoints-61e151d5818442e51e91.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def counts(block, numbers):
    return [sum(line.strip() not in numbers for line in stanza.splitlines()) for stanza in block.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert counts(roman, {'1', '2'}) == counts(body, {'۱', '۲'}) == [2, 4, 4]
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
PY"

Reconstructed all 10 Urdu verses in the selected Markdown file and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the two-line opening and both four-line stanzas align line for line.

Added the Urdu title, retained the Roman alternate title, set right-to-left direction, and removed `noUrdu`. I read “Ahsan” as احسان and “Sheh” as شہ.
